ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_STABILIZATION_BOMB_LONG: Thrown grenade that creates a stabilization field on detonation, equalizing gravity and negating movement for those who enter.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_REDUCTION_BOMB_LONGDESC:
This device, when thrown, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to negate the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to lift enemies or prevent fall damage during traversal.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HUNTER-SEEKER_LONGDESC:
You have been trained in the use of the Hunter-Seeker, a specialized assassination device used to kill enemies without causing alarm. You pilot a thin sliver of metal that, when it strikes, burrows inside the arteries of the enemy and causes them incredible pain and often, instant death. You are vulnerable while piloting the device.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_COMPEL_LONGDESC: A Bene Gesserit technique, Compel is the ability to use one's voice to force another to comply with commands immediately and unconsciously.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_COMPEL_SHORTDESC: Force another to approach against their will
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_AMPLIFICATION_BOMB_LONG:
This device, when thrown, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to amplify the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to slow enemies and drain their power or decrease the speed of projectiles.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SUSPENSOR_WALL_LONGDESC:
You deploy a half-height holtzman shield that provides cover during combat for you and your allies. It will also slow enemies who attempt to pass through it - giving you time to take them down.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SUSPENSOR_WALL_SHORTDES: Deploys a wall of impenetrable energy
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_REMOTE_MINE_LONGDESC: The Explosive Mine is triggered remotely at some distance from its placement. Level up this ability to increase damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_MAGNETIC_ATTRACTOR_LONG:
Originally used as a training device to offset poor aim, the Attractor Field uses a modified Holtzman field to draw attacks towards it’s center. Attach it to an enemy and any shot fired into the field will redirect into their center of mass.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HEALING_CAPSULE_LONGDES: Launches a capsule that bursts on contact, healing its target. Level up this ability to increase the amount of healing.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_REMOTE_STABILIZATION_MI: Variant of the remote mine that creates a stabilization suspensor field at its position, equalizing gravity and negating movement for those caught in the blast.
Detonate to create large stabilization suspensor field
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_WEAPONS_PROJECTION_LONG: Use to scan of nearby characters. Reveals their current weapon and loaded ammo. Level up this ability to increase duration.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_WEAPONS_PROJECTION_SHOR: Scan for enemies in line of sight
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_INJURING_RIPOSTE_LONGDE:
You enter a heightened state of awareness and when next attacked in melee, you parry and counterattack with a savage riposte that bleeds and damages your enemy.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_INJURING_RIPOSTE_SHORTD: Stop and counter an enemy attack
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_BREAKING_RIPOSTE_LONGDE:
You enter a heightened state of awareness and when next attacked in melee, you parry and counterattack with a precise strike that damages their arm and numbs them. For a short period of time, their damage output is reduced.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_BREAKING_RIPOSTE_SHORTD: Stop and counter an enemy attack
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_REMOTE_AMPLIFICATION_MI:
This mine, when triggered, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to amplify the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to slow enemies and drain their power or decrease the speed of projectiles.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
Detonate to create large amplification suspensor field
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_FAR_KNEE_CHARGE_LONGDES: Hold to aim and release to leap forward with a long-range knee attack. Deals a small amount of concussive damage and severely staggers the target. Costs Stamina. Level up this ability to increase damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_REMOTE_REDUCTION_MINE_L:
This mine, when triggered, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to negate the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to lift enemies or prevent fall damage during traversal.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_REMOTE_REDUCTION_MINE_S: Detonate to create large reduction suspensor field
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HEALER-SEEKER_LONGDESC: Medic's remote-controlled drone capable of healing an ally at range.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_KNEE_CHARGE_LONGDESC:
You propel yourself forward into battle with a terrific knee charge into the enemy. Deals damage and severely staggers your opponent, but costs stamina.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_ENEMY_ANALYSIS_LONGDESC: Use to scan of nearby characters. Enemies will show their current health state and equipped abilities. Level up this ability to increase duration.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_ENEMY_ANALYSIS_SHORTDES: Scan for enemies in line of sight
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SLOW_DEFLECTION_LONGDES:
You enter a defensive stance, deflecting darts that are fired at you. This ability lasts as long as your stamina holds out.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_BATTLEFIELD_CALCULATION: Use to scan of nearby characters and objects. Enemies will show their archetype and traps will show their damage type. Level up this ability to increase duration.
Scan enemies and traps in line of sight
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_FAST_DEFLECTION_LONGDES: Enter a defensive stance and deflect dart attacks. Replenishes stamina with each deflection.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SARDAUKAR_PULL_LONG_LON: Fires a barb that attaches to a distant surface and launches the holder towards that position.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SARDAUKAR_PULL_LONG_SHO: Pull yourself to a distant targeted location
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SHIGAWIRE_CLAW_LONGDESC:
You use a wrist-mounted launcher to fire off a claw attached to a cable of shigawire. The extreme tensile strength of shigawire launches you in the direction of the cable. It can also be used to stagger opponents during combat.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_POISON_SPORES_LONGDESC:
You have a hidden dart dispenser that fires off a specially prepared capsule filled with poisonous spores. On impact, a cloud of poison spores appears, building poison on all who remain within.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_FRAG_GRENADE_IMPACT_LON: A sealed metal object filled with high explosives. It uses an impact detonator to scatter fragments of the housing at high velocity.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_FRAG_GRENADE_TIMED_LONG:
You throw a grenade with an explosive core that detonates in a spray of shrapnel, damaging anybody within the radius. Though the shrapnel is incapable of penetrating a shield, the shockwave of the blast can still damage a shielded enemy.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_FRAG_GRENADE_TIMED_SHOR: Explosive that detonates when a timer expires
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HYPERSPRINT_FASTSPEED_L:
You override your nervous system and musculature with an immense surge of activity, allowing you to run forward at an incredible speed.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HYPERSPRINT_FASTTURN_LO: Allows sprinting at high speed. Slower than Hypersprint but allows greater turn responsiveness. Ideal for medium/short range repositioning, particularly in areas with obstacles.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_COMPEL_LONGRANGE_LONGDE:
You use the Voice to force a target to your position from afar. Voice abilities require a short period for you to "register" your opponent before they can be used.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_BLINDSPOT_LONGDESC:
You use the Voice to force your target to ignore you. For a short while, they will act as if you are completely invisible. Voice abilities require a short period for you to "register" your opponent before they can be used.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_COMPEL_SHORTRANGE_LONGD: Force someone to your position from nearby. Speed of target assessment is quick at this distance.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_WEIRDINGSTEP_LONGDESC: Combining the Voice and a limited form of Bindu Sprint - you stun a single enemy while moving with superhuman speed behind them.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_FRAGGRENADE_LONGDESC: XX_This is a deprecated base version. Replace with variant version.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SARDAUKARPULL_LONGDESC: XX_This is a deprecated base version. Replace with variant version.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HYPERSPRINT_LONGDESC: XX_This is a deprecated base version. Replace with variant version.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_BLADEDAMAGESWORDMASTER_: You've learned the difference between a cut and a slice, a point and an edge. You do more damage with bladed weapons.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_RANGEDDAMAGEMENTAT_LONG: You use your considerable mental prowess to calculate the most impactful trajectories for your ranged weapons – increasing your damage with all of them.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_POISONRESISTCONSUMABLE_: This consumable slows down poison absorption to half its usual speed.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_IMPROVEDCAPACITORS_LONG: You have learned to push your power pack beyond its limits, allowing you to increase the maximum power capacity.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_POISONCLOUDSIZE_LONGDES: Your clouds now cover a larger area.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_POISONSLOW_LONGDESC: Your poisons make foes more susceptible to slow and stagger.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_CORPSECLOUD_LONGDESC: Enemies that you kill, or allies that die release a poison cloud after a few moments. Its power magnitude increase with number of active poison stacks or the poison execute ability.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_INCUBATOR_LONGDESC: Poison skills now apply whatever poison stacks you had on your character to empower them.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_CAPSTONEOATH_LONGDESC: Your health over time effects now last longer. While prescient your health over time effects are more powerful.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_CAPSTONEANIGOLAH_LONGDESC: On entering prescient, all existing Anigolah(s) see their health refreshed to full & their duration reset and increased. Existing and new Anigolah(s) also receive the "rage" buff while prescient.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_CAPSTONEPOISON_LONGDESC: Increase poison duration. While prescient increase poison damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_CLOUDSIZE_LONGDESC: Your Clouds now cover a larger area.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_OVERHEALS_LONGDESC: Your healing effects can now over-heal.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_TOUGHHEALS_LONGDESC: Your health-over-time effects are less affected by damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_RAGEANIGOLAH_LONGDESC: When you enter DBNO, your Anigolah(s) are buffed with "rage".
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_EXPLODEANIGOLAH_LONGDES: When Anigolah health falls to low & when their duration nears expiry time, they gain the ability to use an AoE high damage attack that also causes them to die.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_DEATHHEAL_LONGDESC: Anigolah(s) that die heal you instantly for a certain amount of HP.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_PYRETIC_LONGDESC: The suk doctors instruments pyretic conciseness are in flux, and flip between healing and poisoning. Activating abilities flips your flux state between healing/poisoning. Using an ability matching the type gives it a buff.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_TRIAGE_LONGDESC: Nearby allies share damage between each other.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_CAPPLUS_LONGDESC: Raises Anigolah cap by 1, to a new cap of 2.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_TOXIC_LONGDESC: While poisoned, you and your Anigolah(s) gain damage resistance and deal poison stacks from all melee and ranged damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HEALEXPLOIT_LONGDESC: Self or other ally. Whatever health over time effect are active, are now converted into instant heal. If they have not health-over-time effects then apply one.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_FIELDMED_LONGDESC: Point-Blank Area of effect. For each damage event received trigger a health-over-time on the target.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_DEATHRATTLE_LONGDESC: Target enemy corpse.: Create AoE stun shockwave (consumes corpse). Target Anigolah:  Create AoE  stun shockwave and buff Anigolah with rage (higher damage resist and attack).
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_ANIGOLAHRAISE_LONGDESC: Target enemy corpse.  Spawn minion (consumes corpse) for a set duration, then dies. Cap of 1, when a new one is spawned, oldest is replaced - dies.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_EXPUNGE_LONGDESC: AoE Melee self that bypasses shield. Hitting a poisoned enemy will consume the accumulated poison stacks to deal additional damage. Apply poison to target without  poison stacks.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_POISONLAUNCH_LONGDESC:
Target: hostile
Delivery: capsule launcher

Fires a capsule that detonates into a poison Cloud on impact.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_SQUADRON2_LONGDESC: Increases cap of maximum Seekers by one.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_SQUADRON1_LONGDESC: Increases cap of maximum Seekers by one.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_TOWER_LONGDESC: Being stationary builds a damage mitigation based on how long you remain stationary.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_ROOK_LONGDESC: Being stationary builds a damage bonus based on how long you remain stationary.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_DBNOSTAMINA_LONGDESC: Whenever you recover from DBNO you gain bonus stamina.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_DASHDECOY_LONGDESC: Dashing out of Incapacitated state will spawn a Solido-Decoy that dashes in a similar direction if there are available charge.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_DISCHARGE_LONGDESC:
When your Solido-Decoys expire they release an electrical discharge that can stagger and lower the power reserves of those nearby.

This also works when swapping with your Solido-Decoy.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_STAMINABOOSTED_LONGDESC:
When a nearby deployable expires you gain a boost of stamina.

This also works when swapping with your Solido-Decoy.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SHORTCOOLDOWNS_LONGDESC: Whenever a nearby ally's deployable expires your abilities' cooldowns get shorter.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SELFARMOR_LONGDESC: Get bonus damage resistance for each owned nearby active deployable.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_ALLYARMOR_LONGDESC: Your deployables grant damage mitigation to nearby allies.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SEEKERRANGE_LONGDESC: All of your seekers have their combat ranges extended.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_FOCUSFIRE_LONGDESC: If your allies shoot at a target you have recently hit then their damage is increased.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SUSTAINBONUS_LONGDESC: Consecutive hits against the same target result in higher damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SLOWEDPLUS_LONGDESC: Your ranged dart attacks have increased slowing effect.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_RELOADBONUS_LONGDESC: Reloading after a kill grants a damage bonus.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_CAPSTONEMISDIRECT_LONGDESC:
You can now see the location of your Solido-Decoys behind objects.

While Prescient, decoys send out a scan-pulse briefly showing nearby life-signals.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_CAPSTONESEEK_LONGDESC:
Your Seekers have increased duration.

While prescient your Hunter Seeker are more manoeuvrable, your Sentinels are more accurate, your Trophy Seekers intercept two threats and your Solido-Decoys and more resilient.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_CAPSTONECALC_LONGDESC:
After a moment of looking at a target, you see a weakpoint, shooting it will increase damage done.

While prescient the weakpoint is visible and interactable with by your allies.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_POSSFEIGN_LONGDESC:
Voluntarily enter DBNO, making you less of a target and granting momentary invulnerability.

Players who entered this mode can very quickly self-revive.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SOLIDO_LONGDESC:
Deploy a decoy seeker that when activated will spawn a mimic of you and move along the ground.

Re-pressing will activate the decoys and holding will swap places with the nearest.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_HUNTSEEK_LONGDESC:
Deploy and control multiple Seekers to hunt down your foes.

Acts as a burrow-dart against a shielded opponent.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SENTINELSEEK_LONGDESC:
Deploy a Seeker that can shoot at your foes.

Sentinels take time to align to target, and have inaccuracy based on how long they were turning to align to their target.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_TROPHYSEEK_LONGDESC: Deploy a trophy seeker that can interdict slow moving hostile projectiles.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_PERFECTAIM_LONGDESC: Enter a heightened concentration state. Your body synchronizes with weapon firing, reducing recoil and accuracy bloom.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_DBNOPULSE_LONGDESC: Recovering from DBNO causes you to discharge an electric pulse around you which incapacitates your foes and lowers their power supplies.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_REPOSITION_LONGDESC: When you dash out of Incapacitated state and there is a nearby Solido-Decoy, you instead swap places with the decoy and recover from Incapacitated state.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SOLIDODECOY_LONGDESC:
You use a miniature solido projector to project a near-perfect image of yourself onto the battlefield. Triggering it again will force the projection to move forward, fooling enemies into attacking.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SOLIDODECOY_SHORTDESC: Create a decoy that can be remotely triggered
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SUSPENSORBLAST_LONGDESC:
You manipulate the suspensor field generated by your suspensor belt - forcing it to explode around you with extreme force, pushing enemies back, damaging them, and impairing their movement for a short time. You can hold the ability to increase the damage dealt and time the blast release.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SUSPENSORBLAST_SHORTDES: Release a suspensor blast that damages and staggers nearby enemies.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_COLLAPSEGRENADE_SHORTDE: Explosive device that pulls targets to center of implosion.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_COLLAPSEGRENADE_LONGDES:
This device, when thrown, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to attract anybody within a spherical area. Those inside the sphere are drawn together and temporarily stunned, leaving them open to your area of effect attacks.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_DEATHFROMABOVE_LONGDESC:
While you are suspended in the air, any attacks using weapons will have a damage bonus.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_TOUGHLUNGE_LONGDESC:
Lunging at an enemy will often provide them with an easy opening to attack, but you have learned to turn a lunge into an advantage. Sprint attacks provide bonus damage mitigation for a short while after a lunge.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_THRIVEONDANGER_LONGDESC:
When you are low on health, you regenerate health faster, receive less poise damage, and reduce all stamina costs for actions.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_BLADECHAINING_LONGDESC:
Defeating an enemy with a melee attack empowers your next melee attack for a brief period. The skilled swordmaster dances between opponents, keeping their damage high.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_SUSPENSORDASH_LONGDESC:
Your training with suspensors allows you to manipulate your flow of movement. Press the Dash button while suspended to perform a mid-air dash.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_POISONTOOTH_LONGDESC:
Installed by a Suk Doctor, this poison tooth activates when you are killed in combat, causing a cloud of poison mist that damages and poisons anybody nearby.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_COOLDOWNPLANETOLOGIST_L: Reduce the cooldown of Planetologist Abilities. Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_COOLDOWNTROOPER_LONGDES:
The inexperienced and untrained will flinch in the heat of battle, panicked and unable to remember their basic training. Trooper training prepares you for the realities of combat and allows you to use your Trooper abilities more often.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_COOLDOWNSWORDMASTER_LON: Reduce the cooldown of Swordmaster Abilities. Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_COOLDOWNMENTAT_LONGDESC: Reduce the cooldown of Mentat Abilities. Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/STAT_IRONWILL_LONGDESC:
You have developed such a strong sense of self, that you are able to alter your thought patterns to avoid the manipulations of the Bene Gesserit voice at the cost of stamina. At least, those of lesser practitioners.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_WEAPONDURABILITY_LONGDE: Significantly reduce weapon and tool durability loss. Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_COOLDOWNBENEGESSERIT_LO: Reduce the cooldown of Bene Gesserit Abilities. Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_SPRINTSTAMINA_LONGDESC:
When you focus on your technique and breathing, you can recuperate your stamina reserves more quickly.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_VOICEANALYSIS_LONGDESC:
The Voice only works on targets who have been "registered". This technique allows you to focus on registering opponents more quickly, in order to use the Voice faster.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_BINDUSTABILITY_LONGDESC:
Through a combined focus of your nerves and muscles, you are able to resist being staggered by reducing all incoming poise damage.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_METABOLIZEPOISON_LONGDE:
You have developed your internal systems to the extent that any poison you take can quickly be catalyzed and removed from your system, reducing the overall damage poisons deal to you.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_BACKSTABBER_LONGDESC:
Once an enemy is stunned, staggered or knocked back, you strike in vulnerable nerve endings to cause more damage.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_REGENCAP_LONGDESC:
You can use your own body to effectively heal catastrophic damage - improving both the rate at which healing occurs, and the amount.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_POWERDRAIN_LONGDESC:
When you focus your efforts, you can reduce the power drain of every action that you take.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_HEAVYWEAPONSPEED_LONGDE:
You have trained yourself to move faster while using heavy weapons such as the Flamethrower, Lasgun, Vulcan GAU-92 or Missile Launcher.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_HEADSHOTS_LONGDESC:
You are an expert at focusing on the most vulnerable part of the human body, the head. Your headshot damage is increased.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_BODYSHOTS_LONGDESC:
You've been taught to target where you are most likely to hit and you do it by instinct - increasing damage that hits the body or shields, but reducing your damage via headshots.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_HYDRATEDSTAMINA_LONGDES: Your body knows how to make optimal use of water, so you have additional stamina reserves when well-hydrated.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_MAXSTAMINA_LONGDESC: Your extensive physical training has increased your maximum stamina.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SPRINTSTAMINA_LONGDESC: You recover more health immediately when using healkits due to your excellent conditioning.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_STAGGERRESISTANCE_LONGD: As your training increases, you have learned to avoid being knocked around by enemy attacks. You can take more poise damage before being staggered.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_SHADOWSTRIKE_LONGDESC:
Requires Prescience

When your blood is saturated with melange, you see multiple ways in which to damage your enemies. After using any swordmaster ability, your next strike will strike twice, reflecting two possible versions of the future converging in a single spacetime.

The second strike deals 70% of the damage dealt by the initial strike.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_HEATSTROKETOLERANCE_LON: You are able to slow the effects of direct sun exposure on Arrakis, by altering minor chemical reactions occurring in the layers of your own skin, thereby reducing the rate of Sunstroke buildup.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_HANDSCANNERRANGE_LONGDE: You have become proficient with the hand scanner - improving the range of detection.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_CLIMBSTAMINA_LONGDESC: You are better at finding handholds and footholds while climbing, reducing your stamina drain.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_POWERREGEN_LONGDESC: Tinkering with your power pack allows you to increase the recharge rate.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_STILLSUITEFFICIENCY_LON: Though you have no formal training with the stillsuit, you’ve adjusted several seals and tabs that must be properly fitted for the suit to act with optimal efficiency. Your water reclamation while wearing a stillsuit is improved.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_DEWREAPERYIELD_LONGDESC: Careful manipulation of the Holtzman field on the dew reaper allows you to increase the water yield.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_CUTTERRAYYIELD_LONGDESC: Your understanding of structural and mineral composition leads to an increase in the resource yield when using a cutteray.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_HIGHENGAGEMENTYIELD_LON: You develop an understanding of analysis mode mining with the cutteray. Your bonus yields are increased.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_WEAPONDURABILITY_LONGDE: You know how to strip down and clean your gear, slowing the durability cost of firing weapons and tools in hostile environments.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_WEAPONREPAIR_LONGDESC: You are skilled in the repair of weapons and tools reducing the maximum durability cost of each repair.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_APPARELREPAIR_LONGDESC: Your skills with a needle are legendary. Every time you repair a garment, you reduce the maximum durability damage the repair would cause.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_GADGETRELOAD_LONGDESC:
Requires Prescience

When your blood is saturated with the melange, the actions that you have performed a thousand times become effortless. Whenever you throw a grenade or drop a mine, you instantly reload your current weapon – your hands moving before your mind can even think.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_MENTATCOOLDOWNS_LONGDES: Reduces the cooldown of Mentat Abilities.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_HEADSHOTS_LONGDESC: As you train with ranged weapons, you become more proficient at shooting the vulnerable parts of the human body. Your headshot damage is increased.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_RANGEDDAMAGE_LONGDESC: Your time spent practicing your aim leads to bonus damage using all ranged weapons.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_PISTOLDAMAGE_LONGDESC: Handfired weapons are usually less lethal the further away they are, but you have used your mental training to optimize your shots. All damage with pistol style weapons such as the Maula Pistol and Rafiq Subnose is increased.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_RIFLEDAMAGE_LONGDESC: Learning to overcome the drop in trajectory that occurs when a firing rifles at long range, you have increased your lethality with rifles such as the Karpov 38 and JABAL Spitdart. All damage with these weapons is increased.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SCATTERGUNDAMAGE_LONGDE: You have mastered the spread patterns of the pellet firing GRDA 44 and Drillshot FK7 scatterguns, thus improving your damage with these weapons.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_HEAVYWEAPONDAMAGE_LONGD: The bigger the gun, the bigger the mess. Your skill with heavy weapons such as the Flamethrower, Lasgun, Vulcan GAU-92 or Missile Launcher leads to more damage when you use them.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_POISONTOLERANCE_LONGDES: You have tuned your immune system to fight off toxins more effectively. Whenever you are poisoned it takes longer to reach damaging levels.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_BLEEDTOLERANCE_LONGDESC: You have become harder to bleed due to a combination of training and resistance. Bleeding status takes a longer time to build on you.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_MAXHEALTH_LONGDESC: Through careful tuning of your internal enzyme balance and musculature, you can increase your overall health.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_BLADEDAMAGE_LONGDESC: You know exactly where and how to strike with a blade to cause additional damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SHORTBLADEDAMAGE_LONGDE: You've been trained in the use of concealed blades such as daggers and slip-tips. You know precisely where to place these blades for maximum damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_LONGBLADEDAMAGE_LONGDES: Your training with long blades such as swords and rapiers gives you increased damage with those weapons.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SELFHEALING_LONGDESC: You are strongly in touch with your own nervous and immune systems and are able to boost any healing that you perform on yourself.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_VOICESPLASH_LONGDESC:
Requires Prescience

When enough spice permeates your bloodstream, your Voice becomes more powerful, causing those around your registered target to stagger under the force of your commands.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_SHIELDWEAKPOINT_LONGDESC:
Requires Prescience

When your blood is saturated with the melange any ranged attack on a shield will reveal a vulnerability in the Holtzman shield. Continual attacks against this vulnerability will overcharge the enemy shield, causing it to drain their power pack more quickly.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_BINDUDODGE_LONGDESC:
Requires Prescience

When enough spice permeates your bloodstream, you become able to combine your prana-bindu training with your limited ability to see the future. After a successful parry, dart and blade attacks pass through you.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_VEHICLEHEAT_LONGDESC:
Requires Prescience

While under the influence of large amounts of melange, you can instinctively sense where and how to shift a vehicle to reduce heat buildup.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/SPICE_PARRYBOOST_LONGDESC:
Requires Prescience

When your blood is infused with melange, your parries expose additional weaknesses in the defense of your enemies. Their ability to mitigate damage is decreased.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_SUSPENSORPAD_LONGDESC:
Drop a suspensor device that launches yourself (and targets) into the air. Useful for navigation and traversal.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_NERVESTRIKE_LONGDESC:
You tap into your training to deliver a rapid series of powerful, painful strikes to enemies. This attack leaves them temporarily staggered.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_STOP_LONGDESC:
You use the Voice to stop enemies in a cone in front of you from performing any actions for a brief period. Voice abilities require a short period for you to "register" your opponent before they can be used.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_LITANYAGAINSTFEAR_LONGD:
Reciting this litany aloud will instantly hearten any allies nearby, as well as providing you with the strength to push through almost any attacks. You and your allies will have boosted damage mitigation and stagger resistance for the duration.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_WHIRLWIND_LONGDESC:
You pirouette with your blade, becoming a whirlwind of piercing damage that cuts everything around you. While seemingly chaotic, the swordmaster maintains calm - the eye at the heart of the storm.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_CRIPPLINGSTRIKE_LONGDES:
You move in, striking at a low angle to cut your enemies below the knees. For a while after being hit, your enemies are slowed and their dashes require more stamina. While not the most honorable of attacks, the swordmaster understands that there is a difference between a duel and a war.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_BATTLECRY_LONGDESC:
You inspire yourself and your companions to greater heights, increasing the damage of your melee attacks.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_ENERGYCAPSULE_LONGDESC:
You pop an energy capsule, which fills you with a concoction of neurostimulants and pain dampeners. You become detached allowing better targeting and ranged damage.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_POISONMINE_LONGDESC:
You can place a remotely triggered mine that, once triggered, releases a cloud of poisonous spores - stacking poison on all who stand within.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_STUNDART_LONGDESC:
You have a hidden dart dispenser that fires off a specially prepared sedative tipped dart. On impact, this dart stuns the enemy, locking their muscles and rendering them unable to move or attack.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_TURRETSEEKER_LONGDESC:
You deploy a suspensor buoyed dart projector that uses motion detection to cover a field of fire. Trigger a second time to activate.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_PORTABLEGENERATOR_LONGD:
You place out a powerful generator that continuously regenerates power for nearby allies. Though the device uses a form of nuclear fission, it is small enough to be safe provided that it is given adequate time to cool between uses.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/TECHNIQUE_EXPLOITWEAKNESS_LONGDES:
You have learned to observe your enemies and predict their weaknesses based on a thousand minutiae. When you damage an unshielded enemy with a ranged weapon, you reveal a weak point which you can target to increase the damage of subsequent attacks (excluding range AoE attacks). Only one weak point may be visible at a time.

Techniques only take effect when equipped.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_REGENCAP_LONGDESC: You are able to heal your body more effectively after suffering catastrophic injury - regenerating your health to a higher threshold than normal.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_UNSTOPPABLEATTACKS_LONG: Every time you attempt a difficult attack like a sprint attack or a slow blade, you gain increased confidence, which reflects as damage mitigation.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_DEHYDRATEDSTAMINA_LONGD: You have trained yourself to deal with the rigors of the deserts, decreasing your max stamina loss while dehydrated.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SMGDAMAGE_LONGDESC: Using steady hands you are able to guide the disruptor's rapid fire darts more effectively to their target, thus increasing your damage.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_APPARELDURABILITY_LONGD: You are able to spot the flaws in any garment and see where it is most likely to tear first. This allows you to reinforce it, preventing wear and tear. Your garments maintain their durability for longer.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_COMPACTORYIELD_LONGDESC: You've made minor adjustments to the way you use the compactor that improves the efficiency of its resource yields.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SINKCHARTUNLOCK_LONGDES:
You can now create sinkcharts of the areas revealed by your surveys. You also reveal a larger area of the fog of war when traversing the map.

Create sinkcharts from the Map Screen, but you will require a blank sinkchart in your inventory.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SURVEYSPICEDENSITY_LONG: Through research and field experience, you've learned to recognize the density of a spice bed from surveys. This ability is of most use in the Deep Desert.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_VEHICLEREPAIR_LONGDESC: Your field training as a mechanic reduces the maximum durability loss of vehicle components when performing repairs.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_FUELEFFICIENCYAIR_LONGD: Piloting ornithopters has taught you several techniques for fuel conservation while exploring. This applies to all types of ornithopters.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_FUELEFFICIENCYGROUND_LO: Driving groundcars has taught you several techniques for fuel conservation while exploring. This applies to all types of ground vehicles.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_VEHICLEMININGYIELD_LLON: Applying your understanding of structural and mineral composition to heavier vehicle machinery results in a larger resource yield.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_VEHICLESCANNERRANGE_LON: You have become proficient with vehicle mounted scanners - improving the range of detection.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_HARVESTERYIELD_LONGDESC: Your understanding of sand and the vacuum static action of the sandcrawler allows you to harvest spice more efficiently.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_VOICECOOLDOWNS_LONGDESC: Your rigorous training with the Voice allows you to reduce the time between uses.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SUSPENSOREFFICIENCY_LON: Your practice with the suspensor has taught you how to position yourself in the air to remain aerodynamic - reducing the power drain on your suspensor belts.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ABILITIES_ASSAULTSEEKER_LONGDESC:
A modified hunter seeker that will fly in a direct line and explode upon contact with anything. Can be triggered to explode with a second activation. Useful for situations where a thrown grenade is not precise enough.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_SURPRISEATTACK_LONGDESC: You do not squander an advantage in battle. Ever. You deal additional damage to your enemies when shooting them in the back.
ST_Localization_Abilities.SKILLS/ATTRIBUTE_FOWUNLOCK_LONGDESC: Reveal a larger area of the fog of war when traversing the map.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_CRAFTIN:
The <b>Crafting Menu</> allows you to craft useful items from components you find in the world.

Craft a <b>Scrap Metal Knife</> to cut through the membrane blocking your path.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Hydrati:
You need to <b>hydrate</>. 

You can partially replenish your hydration level by drinking <b>Dew</> from <b>Dew Flowers</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Healing: Use a Healkit by selecting it in the <b>Radial Wheel</>, <b>Hotbar</>, or <b>Inventory Menu</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Climbin:
<b>Climbing</> terrain and structures can help you to explore new areas or reach a vantage point.

Climbing will drain your <b>Stamina</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Light: Equip your Glowtube via the Radial Wheel.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Mining:
<b>Cutterays</> can be used to mine ore and extract materials from salvage. 

Cutterays require a working <b>Power Pack</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Shelter:
<b>Sheltered areas</> provide protection from <b>Sandstorms</>. Seek them out to avoid one of the key dangers of Arrakis.

Your shelter status is displayed above the <b>Hydration Bar</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_TechTre:
The <b>Research Menu</> contains designs for equipment and shows the location of necessary components. 

Use <b>Intel</> points to acquire these designs.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Stamina:
<b>Stamina</> drains while climbing. 

Stamina recharges automatically unless you're Sprinting.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Binocul:
<b>Binoculars</> facilitate <b>navigation</> by allowing you to locate points of interest in the environment and set a <b>waypoint</>. 

Equip your Binoculars via the <b>Radial Wheel</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Skills: Spend <b>Skill Points</> in the <b>Skills Menu</> to unlock new Abilities, Techniques, and permanent bonuses.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_ProbeLa: Seek out high points in the region and launch a survey probe to reveal worthwhile information about the surrounding area.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_PlantFi:
<b>Plant Fiber</> can be found and gathered all across Arrakis.
Gather <b>Plant Fiber</> to craft <b>Healkit</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Fabrica: Fabricators are used to craft more complex designs. Multiple designs can be added to a crafting queue. Completed orders will be placed in the fabricator's storage. Fabricators require power to function.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Durabil: Items lose durability with use and when you are defeated. Broken items can no longer be used. Pay attention to the condition of your gear.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Dehydra:
Having your <b>Hydration Level</> above one-third will give you a bonus to your maximum stamina, which is further increased above two-thirds.

When your hydration is below one-third, the bonus to your maximum stamina is removed — when it is empty, you become <b>Dehydrated</> and you will start to lose health until you hydrate again.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Respawn:
<b>Respawn Beacons</> allow you to secure a respawn point should you die. <b>Only</> one beacon can be active at a time. 

Place a <b>Respawn Beacon</> to ensure your continued survival on Arrakis.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Heal: Use a Healkit by selecting it in the <b>Radial Wheel</> or <b>Inventory Menu</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Death:
Arrakis is an unforgiving world, and <b>death</> here is costly. Items in your backpack can be recovered from your death location.

You will lose everything if you are killed by a <b>Sandworm</> or <b>Coriolis Storm</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_DeathRe: Your backpack items are dropped where you die — unless you are killed by a Sandworm or Coriolis Storm, in which case nothing can be recovered.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Respawn: Place a Respawn Beacon. On death, you can respawn at these locations.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Combat: Fight for valuable items and resources. Defeating others is necessary for survival. Equip your knife for combat.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Shield: Equip a Holtzman Shield to deflect and mitigate damage from projectiles. Shields use power which drains with each deflection. They can, however, be recharged.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Communi: Replay incoming messages via the Communinet Menu.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_NPEBino:
Equip your Binoculars via the <b>Radial Wheel</> or <b>Hotbar</>. Aim at the <b>Shipwreck</> to log its location.

<b>Binoculars</> facilitate <b>navigation</> by allowing you to locate points of interest in the environment and set a <b>waypoint</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_NPEPlac: A  <b>waypoint</> can be placed for navigation and reference. Set a waypoint on the distant shipwreck.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Looting:
The bodies of downed enemies can hold vital tools, resources, and components.

Loot the <b>Cutteray</> and <b>Power Pack</> from the body and equip it.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Solaris: Solaris are the currency of the Imperium. They can be used for trade at certain locations or with others you meet in the world.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_MeleeCo: Melee combat is commonplace on Arrakis and requires skill and dexterity.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_XPLevel:
<b>XP</> is earned via combat, resource-gathering, and exploration.

<b>Intel</> and <b>Skill Points</> are granted as rewards for leveling up. Use them wisely.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_RadialW:
You can change your <b>Loadout</> items in the <b>Inventory Menu</>.

Equip them by using the <b>Radial Wheel</>. Items will be automatically equipped into empty slots.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Placeho: Placeholder text to describe the tutorial steps. The text should be as short and concise as possible.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Abiliti: Equip and use up to 3 powerful Abilities. Unlock more Abilities through leveling up and spending Skill Points.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Unspent:
You have unspent <b>Skill Points</>.

Spend your Skill Points in the <b>Skills Menu</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_HeatExh:
Spending time in the sun will fill up the sunstroke bar. Once filled you will be affected by <b>Sunstroke</> which increases dehydration rate.
To avoid and remove <b>Sunstroke</>, stick to the shadows.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Unspent: You have unused Intel. Use your Intel in the Research Menu.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Salvage:
<b>Salvage metal</> is scattered across Arrakis and can be repurposed into a range of basic tools.

Small pieces can be picked up from the ground, while larger pieces of wreckage need to be mined with a <b>Cutteray</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_BuriedT: In the wake of a storm use a Scanner to look for hidden treasures beneath the sand and uncover them with a Static Compactor.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Scanner: The Scanner will reveal various things like components, vehicles, bases and people within its scan range.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Sandwor:
This bar in the center of the screen shows the <b>vibrations</> you are making on open sand — vibrations will attract the <b>Sandworms</>.
When the vibration bar <b>turns red</>, seek safety immediately—the sandworm is nearby.

The closer a worm is, the more sensitive it is to vibrations. Take the utmost care crossing the open desert!
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_BaseShi: The Sub-fief console is capable of generating a shield protecting your base from enemies and reducing sandstorm damage. Provide power to your base to activate its shield.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_DewHand:
<b>Dew Flowers</> will only fill up to one-third of your Hydration. Consuming too much will cause <b>nausea</>.

Seek more efficient <b>Hydration</> sources to fully quench your thirst.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Debuffs:
An on-screen icon will let you know when you are suffering from a <b>negative effect</>.

Negative effects that have a <b>duration</> will also display how long the effect lasts.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Radiati: Radiation can be a danger in the desert. Equip a Radiation Suit or use a Radiation Pill to negate or decrease the effects.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Harvest: Open the Communinet Menu to listen to Harvester Radio. The station provides a variety of entertainment, including dramas, interviews, and music.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Favouri:
You can mark <b>one</> item for <b>Quick Swap</> on the Loadout wheel in the Inventory menu. Use this to quickly swap to and from the selected item.

Your Maula pistol has been pre-assigned for now. Look for it on the <b>HUD.</>

Double tap the Holster button to Quick Swap your items.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_StatusS: Open the <b>Status Screen</> to see more detailed information about your character and the world.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Movemen: Move your character by pressing on the [LS] or [WASD].
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Generat: The Fuel-Powered Generator requires Fuel Cells to generate power. Add Fuel Cells to your base storage before Processing them in the Fuel-Powered Generator.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_FuelCel: Fuel Cells are required to power your Base Shields and infrastructure. Collect and process them at a Fuel-Powered Generator to power your base.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Unlocki: You have completed the Journey step required to unlock a new Fremkit item design. View the Stillsuit design in the Research Menu.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_BuyReci: Imperial Permits are required to craft Unique Items. Additional permits can be acquired by finding and using Schematics.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Special: Many items require specialized components to craft. These items and their required components share the same color and marker. Find these components at the locations indicated by their marker.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_BasePow: Most base systems require power to be functional. Build a Power Generator to power up your systems.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_SpiceDr:
You have experienced a Spice Dream.

On awakening, you are protected from harm for a short time. Move to continue your Journey.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_MiningD: <b>Cutterays</> can also be used to cut through doors and access blocked areas.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_MiningA:
The <b>Cutteray</> is used for mining resources.

The <b>Analysis Mode</> displays hidden <b>structural weaknesses</> that can be traced with the Cutteray laser to yield greater resource amounts.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_PurifyB: Place a <b>Blood Purifier</> in your base to start turning the blood you've collected into <b>drinkable water</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Introdu: Collect blood from bodies you find using the <b>Improvised Blood Extractor</> and <b>Small Blood Sack</>. You can drink this to gain hydration.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DECK_DESCRIPTION_WAR: Arrakis is the battleground of a long and brutal war between House Atreides and House Harkonnen. Will you be caught in the crossfire? Or seize the opportunity to make new allies?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_JOI: The War of Assassins has turned into a protracted nightmare on Arrakis. With resources and troops dwindling, House Atreides and House Harkonnen seek allies and agents at the Anvil Tradepost. The Great Houses can be powerful friends… and worse enemies. Whom do I dare back?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_TALKTOARE: Strike a deal with a recruiter
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_FINDTHESP: Complete contract "FACTIONS: JOINING RANKS: The Missing Spy" for House Atreides or House Harkonnen
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_CLI: It takes time to build trust, especially in the world of espionage. I found a sponsor and proved my worth — albeit as a deniable asset. I’ll need to put time and effort into cultivating this relationship with my adopted House if I want to improve my status.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_TALKTOT2A: Deliver your report to Andrea Ganan at Helius Gate
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_TALKTOT2H: Report to Simone Von Konig at Riftwatch
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_GAT: A mysterious and gory ailment ravages Arrakeen, presenting the exact same symptoms as those victims we found in the wreck of the Kytheria. Is it a disease or chemical? Is it an accident or something weaponized? Who could be behind this? More importantly: could this give my House and I an edge in this war?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_TALKTOT3A: Talk to Thufir Hawat in Arrakeen
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_TALKTOT3H: Talk to Piter de Vries in Harko Village
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_ATR:
<i>While this Journey is active, you cannot defect from your faction.</>

The spice I found in the Sandflies base needs to be analyzed before any conclusion can be drawn. Was Skorda purposefully smuggling a lethal poison on Arrakis? Until we get more answers, I must move swiftly to neutralize the main peddler of this poison in Arrakeen.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_RECOVERBA: Recover the tainted spice in the Sheol
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_DESCRIPTION_TAX: The Emperor has decreed that all who make Arrakis their home must pay the Imperial Solari Tax or face the consequences. Imperial Tax Representatives, located in Arrakeen and Harko Village, can accept tax payments and provide details on the consequences of tax delinquency.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_GOAL1_TAXATION: Collect Solaris and put them in your backpack (6500)
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_GOAL3_TAXATION: Speak with an Imperial Tax Representative about paying your taxes
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_TAXATION_DESCRIPTIO:
The Emperor requires all who make Arrakis their home to pay the <b>Imperial Solari Tax</> or face the consequences.

<b>Imperial Tax Representatives</> located in <b>Harko Village</> and <b>Arrakeen</> can accept tax payments and inform of the consequences of tax delinquency.

A new <b>Journey</> is now available to guide you through this process.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_JOIN: The War of Assassins is taking its toll on the troops, and there's deep animosity brewing between House Atreides and House Harkonnen, nowhere as visible as in the Anvil tradepost, where I witnessed a dispute barely contained by the laws of kanly. After locating a missing spy on the trail of Atreides deserter Captain Tighe Skorda, I have taken the first steps towards gaining favor with one of these immemorial powers on Arrakis.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_CLIM: As a deniable asset, I have now been sent into hostile territory and covert field operations several times. I'm slowly proving my worth to my sponsor and to his House. Besides, I'm getting the sense that things are ramping up, both in intensity and importance — I had better find this Katrina Chloros quickly.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_GATH: I have picked up the trail of the mysterious cargo among the Sandflies and got my hands on a canister of seemingly innocuous spice. Without a doubt however, it is the cause of all those gruesome deaths. My sponsor sent it to be analyzed. In the meantime, I better avoid ingesting it. Or even touching it.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_ATRE: Andrea Ganan's plans to test the tainted spice on a wealthy and well-protected traitor has been foiled. I am now in the service of the famous Thufir Hawat, Master of Assassins of House Atreides and one of the most famous Mentat there is.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_VG_MIDGAME_CARD_COMP: Well, I cleared out the Testing Station for its former inhabitants, and helped someone get revenge on some Kirab bandits, but my employer on that second job wasn't exactly honest with me before I took the contract. Is that kind of deception common here?

Vermillius contains many stretches of open sand; travelling across it by ground will always be hazardous. Mirzabah's hammer will be a useful landmark for navigation in the Basin, and I must remember the Ironworks if I need more of that metal in future.

The Holtzman Shield truly is a marvel — I now understand why it has shaped millennia of Imperial combat doctrine. And yet…it enrages the worm like nothing else I have seen. I must be careful and deliberate in its use, or it could easily call my death upon me.

Sword, Scattergun, Disruptor, Armor: with these tools, I will survive. The sword meets multiple enemies blade-to-blade. The Scattergun brings close-in brutality. The Disruptor overpowers shielded foes. Heavy Armor turns aside the blades and darts of my enemies. I grow stronger, and now I go to face greater challenges.

A small personal touch can make a big difference! Furniture and decorations help me upgrade a base into something a little more like a home. I'm still stuck out in the wild hinterland of the most dangerous planet in the universe, but that doesn't mean I can't make myself comfortable.

With a Welding Tool to repair my vehicles, and a Repair Station in my base for my personal gear, I can keep equipment working much longer. It seems, though, that the wear and tear of desert use will catch up with everything in the end. When it does, a Recycler at least allows me to extract the remaining useful resources from worn-out technology.

Such an elegant piece of technology! I can gather water with a Dew Reaper and Literjon much faster than with blood extraction…but only if I can be ready before dawn to work the dewfields. I need to decide if it's worth planning my day around this activity.

Flour sand, personal notes: look for plumes of white dust above open sand; hand-harvesting is too slow, use a compactor; refine to silicone in a Chemical Refinery; and beware the worm. Above all, always beware the worm.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_JE_MIDGAME_CARD_COMP: Spires riddled with sharpshooters, hollows infested with slavers, and the night skies patrolled by Sardaukar dropships — Jabal Eifrit is not a welcoming region. I'll need to return if I need carbon or advanced servoks in bulk, but there must be safer places to settle.

Tentative conclusion: if you want to really hit someone hard, you need Steel components. The Spitdart and Snubnose deliver far more punch than previous weapons, and the Dirk seems similarly lethal. Scout Armor clearly offers less protection than the Heavy variant, in exchange for better water discipline and ease of movement.

Well, it's slower than the Sandbike, but the Buggy does indeed have far more carrying capacity, and also handles rough terrain more easily. The CHOAM research manual also makes reference to a Mining Laser attachment — I should investigate that configuration soon.

These new fabricators certainly expand my crafting options, but their combined power draw is significant. Powering them off through their Management consoles when I don't need them is probably the best short-term solution.
A portable, hands-free light is a useful thing in the dark places of Arrakis. I expect to get plenty of use out of this handy tool!

The bankers in Arrakeen and Harko Village will happily hold onto my Solaris until I need them. I gain from increased safety for my money; I'm sure there's something they're getting out of it too. It seems all the merchants are willing to take bank credit as payment too, so I can transact without needing to carry physical currency!

The Thumper is typical of Fremen equipment: robust, reliable, and unreasonably effective. Placed on open sand, this simple device unerringly draws nearby worms to its location. Several uses for this come to mind immediately, and I'm sure more will reveal themselves over time.

Hagga Rift — what a place! It's almost like stepping down into another planet. The Deserter bases threaded into the walls are a challenge, but to find somewhere in this desert so cool and dark and green is truly a surprise. If I need Cobalt in the future, I'll surely be returning to the Rift's mining galleries to harvest Erythrite.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT1_EPILOGUE_CARD_C: Ari reached out to let me know that she has been unable to locate an Ixian decoder. She has asked me to search the cities and villages - suspecting that a Black Market Trader in Harko Village might have what we need.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_INTRO_CARD_COMP:
After being interrogated by the Sardaukar, I found myself being questioned by Count Hasimir Fenring, one of the Emperor's most trusted men.
Fenring explained that I have been imprinted with hypno-ligation, a compulsion, and that we have common cause in trying to find its source.
I had no choice but to work with Fenring, and was sent to meet his contact, a woman named Elara Tuek. Elara had tasks for me - straight from the Assassin's Handbook.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_SECONDTARGET_CA: After completing my first assassination, I returned to Elara Tuek, who gave me the next assassination task.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_FURTHERINSTRUCT: With no new assassination targets, I returned to Hagga Basin. I had a new spice dream, a very disturbing one that ended with a ship crashing from the sky. Once the dream ended, Ariste reached out to me and told me that an Ixian ship had crashed in the desert, and that I should get there quickly if I wanted to find an Ixian decoder.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_THEJACKAL_CARD_: Following the instructions of Elara Tuek, I found the Jackal in the twisting alleyways of Arrakeen and killed him. But not before he told me I was not the first to have the mission, Find the Fremen, Wake the Sleeper. It is all connected to Fenring, but before I could go back to Harko and confront Elara, Ariste reached out with a new task.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_LASTTARGET_CARD: After assassinating the Water Shipper I returned to Elara Tuek to report my success. She gave me no new answers, but instead asked me to perform a final assassination.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_ANEWTARGET_CARD: After my adventure in the Wreck of the Hephaestus, Elara Tuek reached out again and told me she had more work. I returned to Harko Village and received a new assassination mission.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_WATERFAT_CARD_C: Following the instructions of Elara Tuek, I slipped into the mansion of a Water Shipper outside Arrakeen. I poisoned his water supply - but before I could escape he confronted me. He told me that he understood that I had been sent to check on him, but that his plan to find the fremen was almost complete. When he drank the water and died, he begged me to save him and hinted that he knew a way around the compulsion...but it was too late.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_MEETINGARISTE_C:
Zantara crashed my meeting with Ari in Arrakeen, and it is obvious that they have some history. After some squabbling, we used the Ixian decoder to finally reveal the contents of the minmic film. It as a recording from the same figure we had seen in the sietch - Alnaëm. The Sleeper. He claims to be a chosen of the Fremen, known as the Lisan al-Gaib, and he claims to have the same mission as I - to Find the Fremen. But having found them, he now seeks to help them.
He encoded a location on the film - one that he claims holds answers. I must meet Zantara in Harko and then we will find out the truth.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_OLDCARTHAG_CARD:
Zantara is dead. Dead by my hand. In the darkness of a lab beneath Old Carthag, I was compelled to kill him by a Tleilaxu Facedancer. The Reverend Mother who gave me my pain box test was a lie. My life, my memories. A lie.
I am a ghola, grown from the flesh of a corpse. I lived another life, one that I know nothing about.
I have so many questions. What do the Tleilax want? How many other ghola are there? What is Fenrings interest in all of this? But above all, who am I? Who was I? Perhaps Ariste or Fenring can help me find the answers.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_EPILOGUE_CARD_C: With Ariste unable to meet me and Elara Tuek giving me the cold shoulder, it seems as though I need to just live my best life on Arrakis until they are free to speak with me once again.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_OH_LATEGAME_CARD_COM:
I have flown high above the surface of Arrakis, free from gravity and the worm and the grind of sand beneath my boots. It is glorious.

I am surely my own master now.

It's clear why the Fremen view the Stilltent as a vital survival tool — not only is it a comfortable place to rest, it also allows one to survive sandstorms in comfort, even when no convenient shelter is nearby. It doesn't seem likely it would stand up to a Coriolis Storm, though.

I have it! The Spice, the geriatric melange, the most valuable substance in the universe, and the hardest to acquire. I braved the sand, and the worm, and the spice itself, and returned triumphant. With sand, rich with precious Spice! Now I must determine how to separate and refine it...

An interesting selection of tools, these. The Rapier is an elegant weapon, that I know the Atreides favor for its precision. The Vulcan GAU-92, by contrast, is brute strength, but effective all the same. The Drillshot FK7's burrowing darts are an intriguing capability, opening up a new dimension to shielded combat. And Heavy Armor...remains heavy armor — still reliable, but still not without drawbacks.

The Sheol, as it seems to be named, is indeed a radiation-blasted wasteland. The suit I have fabricated will mitigate the effects of that radiation, but only for a time — if I do not carefully manage my dosage, it will still prove fatal eventually. Leaving the area seems to swiftly mitigate the immediate effects; I must trust that the long-term consequences are similarly manageable...

Plastone bases in the improved CHOAM style are a clear improvement over the basic stone base — in ruggedness, in functionality, in aesthetics. I have seen, though, Atreides and Harkonnen structures in their own style. Is it possible to acquire such construction styles for my own use?

The Shield Wall is everything I expected: a high, solid expanse of rock, mercifully free of worms and gratifyingly dense with Aluminum. The O'odham is not at all what I expected. Such greenery, in the open, on Arrakis! The past efforts of Testing Station No. 163 play their role here, for certain, but what part is played by the vicious Maas Kharet and their warped religion?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_SL_LATEGAME_CARD_COM: Success! The flowers of the O'odham Agave plant are a suitable raw material for Iodine Pills. These should allow me to spend longer in the radiated areas of the Sheol without ill effects.

The tangled wreckage of this mausoleum is even more radioactive close up — investigating the hulls of the larger ships presents a particular challenge, but one sure to reward success handsomely. How the pools of strange liquid dotting the landscape somehow develop formations of Jasmium crystal is still a mystery, but I will surely make use of this good fortune, for Duraluminum is among the Imperium's strongest and lightest metals.

Yes: the "Deathstill" (as the name seems to translate) renders human remains down into clean water and a dessicated waste mass. Well then. I will have to decide for myself what to do with this knowledge.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DD_HARVESTING_CARD_C: We have begun the process of exploiting the vast Spice fields of the Deep Desert. It will be slow and arduous work, and there will be setbacks, but the rewards are clearly worth it. Spice is everything, and we have the Spice. Now we must control it.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DD_ROCKET_CARD_COMPL: This Missile Launcher is indeed a worthwhile tool — when we need to bring down hostile aircraft, there are few better options. I wonder how big a ship it could bring down…
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DD_BASE_CARD_COMPLET: With the aid of the Solido Replicator, we can quickly erect and dismantle substantial bases in the Deep Desert. Quick to build means gaining a lead on our competitors. Quick to demolish allows us to stay active until right before the Storm arrives. This is an operation we will no doubt become experts at.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DD_VEHICLES_CARD_COM: The Sandcrawler vastly improves our harvesting capabilities, but is so slow as to be unusable on its own. The Carrier Ornithopter unlocks its full potential, allowing us to deploy and recover Sandcrawlers as needed. We will need to be cautious with them, as both are vulnerable and valuable targets.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DD_EXPLORATION_CARD_: I have a taste for this place, now, and a thirst for its riches. The Coriolis Storm will undo my work in time, but until then, I have knowledge of the open desert. That knowledge may be valuable to others, perhaps?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_LANDSRAAD_PART2_CARD: We have drawn the attention of larger powers, and sworn fealty to our chosen liege. Now we must fulfil our part in the agreement, and trust that he fulfils his.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_LANDSRAAD_PART1_CARD: We successfully asserted our dominance over a key location in the Deep Desert. Our political allies are pleased. They will have more requests. We will fulfil them.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_HBS_BASETEARDOWN_CAR: The Solido Replicator allowed me to store a blueprint of my base, which can then be placed down elsewhere. I still needed to deconstruct the old base manually, but the resources could then be reused. This allows to move my center of operations as needed, which will surely be useful as I continue my journey.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_HBS_VEHICLEBACKUPTOO: Two is one and one is none: I should never leave home without a spare vehicle backed up and a Tool in hand. For now, the sandbike is sufficient, but eventually I will always want a backup ornithopter available.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_HBS_TAXI_CARD_COMPLE: I was right — the tradeposts are supplied by Arrakeen and Harko Village. Thopter pilots will carry me between those places and the Tradeposts in Hagga Basin, but they are scoundrels and will not fly without payment up front.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_STILLSUIT_COMPL: After I completed the first trial, my mind was filled with the knowledge to create a stillsuit. I had to scavenge the former caves of the Fremen and create a fabricator, but in the end I was able to complete a stillsuit, which will allow me to survive in the heat of the desert.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_BLOOD_COMPLETIO: Water is scarce on Arrakis, and the most convenient source available to me right now is the blood of my enemies. I crafted a blood extractor and a purifier, and learned to take the blood from enemies and deposit it in the purifier. I am not sure how I feel about any of this.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_BUILDING_COMPLE: Zantara warned me that the sandstorms that sweep across the desert will tear the flesh from my bones. Following Zantara's guidance, I crafted a construction tool, placed a sub-fief console to claim land, built a small base, and powered my shield with a generator.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_COMBAT_COMPLETI: Desperate Scavengers cling to survival by salvaging debris from the War of Assassins. They attacked me on sight, so I killed them. It is as Zantara suggested - there are no innocents out here.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_SURVEY_COMPLETI: After crafting a survey probe and launcher, I made my way to civilization - in the form of a tradepost. Here I was able to find contracts, traders and trainers. But no Zantara. He was forced to leave due to the sizeable bounty on his head. I'll find him later.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_SHIPWRECK_COMPL: Following my foray into civilization, I went to explore the Wreck of the Alcyon, an Atreides frigate that had been shipwrecked nearby. After exploring, I had enough specialized components to craft new weapons and armor. Zantara radioed to let me know that he has crossed the Vermillius Gap and is still being pursued. I suppose we'll meet later.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_SANDBIKE_COMPLE: After a foray into a testing station, I gathered the components for crafting my one man groundcar and assembled it. Now I am finally ready to head north, across the Vermillius Gap and find Zantara.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_ESCA: The prison transport was shot down, and I awoke in a cave, saved by the accident by a mysterious man known as Zantara. But the Sardaukar locked down the area, trapping us with the prisoners and guards. I had to fight my way to the bridge of the ship, and activate a transmitter, in order to lure a Sardaukar Bakkar to the ground. Zantara killed the man and we escaped in a stolen Ornithopter, right into the teeth of a raging sandstorm...
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_LOADOUT_COMPLET: With Zantara guiding me over the communinet, I crafted a makeshift outfit from plant fiber, a maula pistol and darts. Being equipped is the first step.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_FIRS:
Remember Harmonthep, where our children were taken and made slaves! The words of the mysterious figure ring in my mind. Was it another dream? A vision? How then, have I awoken with this knowledge in my mind? Of how to craft a stillsuit. And the path to the next trial, engraved in the stone. Engraved in my mind.
I will need to pursue this, but only once I have gotten myself across the sands to the Vermillius Gap.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_SECO: Another vision, this one lost in the memories of a people searching for their future. What is the meaning of thought? Even now the memory of the dream evaporates, leaving me with three things. The name of a planet, Rossak where they found the poison drug, the making of a Fremen static compaction tool, and the location of the next trial that I must face.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_THIR: At the location of the third trial, I found nothing but the degradations of the Sardaukar. Defiled and defaced, there was no trial to undertake, just a lonely shigawire left by wandering scholar, almost as disappointed as I am. At least she managed to decipher the Fremen runes enough to find the words “slave cribs” “hajj” and “Bela Tegeuse”.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_FOUR: Another trial, this one by combat. As I fought the shades of the Sardaukar from Salusa Secundus, something awoke inside me. Perhaps through the influence of the spice, perhaps through the influence of these visions, I find myself at times able to see beyond this moment.
