The future is a ceaseless, shifting path, but I can see enough to give me a slight advantage in combat. There is more to these trials than simple training. Perhaps the next holds more answers.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_FIFT: One more trial and I feel the weight of the past settle on me. I have seen the Fremen and their ruthless use of the desert against their enemies. Shai-Hulud… their god? And the planet, Poritrin, where the Zensunni were punished for their complacency. Is there a link between them? I don’t know. But I must find out. Another trial awaits, somewhere ahead.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_SIXT: Deep in Jabal Eifrit, another destroyed altar. There is something very profane about the destruction the Sardaukar have wrought here — defilement of an entire people and their history. The mysterious scholar has been here as well, in the aftermath. Her notes mention Thurgrod, another planet of the Zensunni migration. Are the Fremen remnants of the Zensunni wanderers? The answers lie ahead, in another location carved in stone.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_SEVE:
There was something… different about this trial. Apocalyptic. The voice of the Fremen still lingers. Kralizec, the typhoon struggle. What does it do to a people to believe their purpose is to fight in a war at the end of the universe?
Remember Nilotic al-Ourouba, the start of a long journey, they told me. And a final trial awaits.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_ATES: I helped Lieutenant Anton Tolliver in his efforts to undermine Levenbrech Maxim Kazmir, the Harkonnen recruiter, and all it took was revealing the truth of the man's questionable Semuta dealings... and embezzlement of war funds. I have taken a side in this war of assassins. House Atreides is a noble and unwaveringly righteous House, embroiled in a dirty conflict. I pray I didn't choose wrong.

I helped Levenbrech Maxim Kazmir in his efforts to slander Lieutenant Anton Tolliver, the Atreides recruiter, and all it took were some slightly altered documents... I have taken a side in this war of assassins. House Harkonnen is a House of opportunity and deceit, in which I can thrive... or be undone. I pray I didn't choose wrong.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_HUNT: I have tracked down Skorda and found him before the Maas Kharet and his mysterious pursuers—gravely ill, but alive. He revealed to me that he found the tainted spice on Ix, and had no idea of its lethality. Two other ships had similar cargo, but were shot down over the Sheol—only the Kytheria's could be recovered. Skorda simply intended to sell the spice, escape the war and live a quiet life somewhere in the Imperium. Arrakis will be his grave instead.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_HARK: Simone Von Konig's devious plan to assassinate and take the place of the Master of Assassins of House Harkonnen, Piter de Vries, has been foiled. I was supposed to take the fall for it, but instead entered de Vries' service. I can't decide if I should be ecstatic or apprehensive after this swift promotion...
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_INVE: I have found that Tighe Skorda smuggled a mysterious cargo aboard the Kytheria, which has infected the crew who came in contact with it. They all died a gruesome death... Katrina Chloros was the last survivor. And now there are none. I have evidently stumbled upon something much bigger than anticipated, and find myself now in the service of an intelligence officer and mentat in my House.

I have recovered one of the containers of poisoned spice from the Sheol; unfortunately the enemy also got their hands on one. I have proved my worth to Piter de Vries, and have been inducted into House Harkonnen proper by swearing fealty to Beast Rabban himself. But many questions remain: how was this spice tainted? For what purpose? Who is behind this? This investigation is far from over...

I have recovered one of the containers of poisoned spice from the Sheol; unfortunately the enemy also got their hands on one. I have proved my worth to Thufir Hawat, and have been inducted into House Atreides proper by swearing fealty to the Duke himself. But many questions remain: how was this spice tainted? For what purpose? Who is behind this? This investigation is far from over...
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_THES:
The last stop on my journey through the Trials of Aql brought me to Sietch Talab. Though the sietch was locked and abandoned, I used knowledge gleaned from the trials to make my way inside.
There, I was confronted by a scholar named Ari.
We agreed to explore together, eventually stumbling upon a recording left by a mysterious figure – who seem to share my quest to find the Fremen.
We found a minimic film containing more information about this mysterious person – but the film is encrypted with Ixian technology. When the Maas Kharet invaded the sietch, Ari and I fled.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_COMPLETION_TAXA: I have paid my taxes. Long live the Emperor. I expect I'll have to return to Arrakeen or Harko Village again in future, to pay more taxes.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_HEPHAESTUS_CARD: An Ixian wreck. A strange noble. A ship full of suboids. Exploring the Wreck of the Hephaestus was definitely more than I had bargained for. But I know the heir to House Harkonnen now and I found the Ixian decoder - so now I just need to wait to hear from Ariste. Again.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_GLUTTON_CARD_CO: Elara Tuek asked me to assassinate a new leader who was rising among the Slavers of the Hagga Basin. I found this leader, known as the Glutton and killed him, after witnessing his horrible acts of cannibalism. Oddly enough, when he died, a marking similar to the one on my face, briefly glowed beneath his skin.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_PARANOID_CARD_C: Elara Tuek asked me to assassinate a cult leader who has taken over the power station of Mysa Tarill in the Hagga Basin. After killing her guardians, I was able to bypass her prudence shield and confront her. She spoke of a mission to find the fremen, and when she died, a sub-dermal tattoo began to glow.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/KEYSTONE_ARMORAUGMENTSLOT_DE: Allows additional augments to be slotted onto armors.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/KEYSTONE_MELEEAUGMENTSLOT_DE: Allows additional augments to be slotted onto melee weapons.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/KEYSTONE_RANGEDAUGMENTSLOT_D: Allows additional augments to be slotted onto ranged weapons.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/KEYSTONE_CONSUMABLEBATCHCRAF: When crafting consumable objects such as healkits, ammo, and spice consumables, there is a chance to produce twice as many.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/KEYSTONE_CRAFTINGJACKPOT_DES: Increases the chance for better stats when crafting augments.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/KEYSTONE_CRAFTINGSPEED_DESC: Increases the speed of all crafting and refining.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/KEYSTONE_GHOSTDATA_DESC: Chance to gain twice as many permits when learning a schematic.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_BETR: House Harkonnen is on a path of self-destruction I had no intention of taking to its end. I have defected from their ranks and cast my lot with House Atreides instead.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_BET:
<i>While this Journey is active, you can no longer progress with Harkonnen. Complete the betrayal contract to continue climbing up the ranks with Atreides instead.</>

I have made my choice. The Harkonnens have used me, I have used them. I'm calling it quits before I find myself with a blade in my back or chaumurky in my drink. I am joining House Atreides, but first I must prove to them that I am willing to make an enemy of their enemy...
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_COMPLETION_BETR: It is done. I have betrayed House Atreides to join the ranks of House Harkonnen. I am no longer shackled by limp virtue and the self-righteous mediocrity of the weak. From now on, I will take what I want.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_BET:
<i>While this Journey is active, you can no longer progress with the Atreides. Complete the betrayal contract to continue climbing up the ranks with the Harkonnen instead.</>

I have made my choice. It is clear to me now that I never could have reached my full potential as long as I worked for the Atreides. I now need to prove to House Harkonnen that I can be useful to them. It is time to join the winning side of the war. The side that does not burden itself with stale idealism... and petty morality.

Committing to one side of the War of Assassins gives you access to new contracts and special merchants. You can now also participate in the <b>Landsraad</> to win better rewards.

The Sub-Fief Console is the control center of a base and where you manage player <b>permissions</>, <b>storage</> and <b>power distribution</>.

<b>Landclaim</> is an area around the sub-fief console. This area defines where you can build.

Change the <b>elevation</> and <b>rotation</> of the Sub-Fief Console by following the commands at the right hand side of the screen.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_TRADING: At <b>Tradeposts</> you can find merchants for buying and selling, a Contract Board with employment opportunities, ornithopter pilots willing to transport you elsewhere, and a convenient shelter from storms.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_CONTRAC:

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C3_FACTION_ATRE_2_:
<i>While this Journey is active, you cannot defect from your faction.</>

Once again, Duke Leto Atreides commands my presence. Another task, another opportunity to prove my loyalty to House Atreides.

A Harkonnen trap destroyed an Atreides unit led by Captain Moser, putting a vital intelligence asset in enemy hands. Duke Leto commanded me to recover said asset. I found Captain Moser barely alive. As he died, he spoke of still living Atreides captives. Against orders, I rescued these soldiers, but in doing so, I lost the intelligence asset. I can only hope I have not doomed the war effort.

Beast Rabban commanded me to be his instrument of revenge against Gurney Halleck. A false distress call lured a group of Atreides soldiers to an outpost. I gassed the whole unit with neurotoxin, executed the poisoned survivors, recovered a snitch, and defeated Halleck’s young pup Captain Moser, leaving the bloodied but breathing man hanging as a fine present for Lord Rabban.

The CHOAM manual suggests Iodine Pills can be fabricated from various biological compounds — including some found in Agave Flowers. Such flowers can be found in the O'odham! Perhaps I can improve my capabilities further here.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_OH_LATEGAME_CARD_DES: The Shield Wall, famous across Arrakis for its solidity and strength and air of safety. And here, tucked behind it, a place spoken of only in whispers, half-awed, half-afraid. I must map them both.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_OH_LATEGAME_CARD_DES: Looking south from Mysa Tarill, the glow hanging over the starship graveyard looks unhealthy — much like that wreckage in the Vermillius Gap that turns out to be highly radioactive. If I want to explore the graveyard, I should probably find a way to protect myself.
As my foes become more powerful and more sophisticated, I need to keep pace. Aluminum allows for another widening of my arsenal, and I must make use of this if I am to reach my goals.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_OH_LATEGAME_CARD_DES: It is no longer avoidable: I must harvest the Spice, the source of all wealth and woe on this planet, in order to proceed. The obvious danger is the worm, but I am told that the subtle danger is the spice itself…
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_OH_LATEGAME_TASK_TIT: Harvest Spice with a Static Compactor while wearing a Spice Mask
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_OH_LATEGAME_CARD_DES: I've learned of another piece of Fremen equipment — a Stilltent, which preserves moisture and provides shelter from sandstorms. This would surely be useful to me — I should acquire one.
Aluminum is the first metal I've found that's light enough for a viable aircraft. I briefly flew a Sardaukar ornithopter with Zantara after the crash — it's time I got back into the skies on my own.

My victories multiply, but the fighting arena is insatiable. Soon I will face my next opponent: Thrax the Flamer. Even Maksim seems a little nervous of Thrax’s lust for fire...

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C3_ARTOFKANLY_5_DE:
The fight with Sinnu the Poisoner proved to be one full of deadly revelations. Sinnu revealed themself to be the face dancer, nearly killing me. And the Dancer of Veils revealed himself to be Feyd Rautha, saving me from the former... 

Before dying, the Face Dancer mentioned something about trouble with the Smugglers. That may be my next lead.

The fighting arena awaits. Soon I will face my next opponent: Sinnu the Poisoner, some sort of worm-cultist from the wastes. He is my last opponent before I can face the Dancer of Veils... our face dancer.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_EPILOGUE_CARD_D: After the shock of events beneath Old Carthag, I need to talk to somebody about it. I must wait for Ariste to contact me so we can discuss all that has happened.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_OLDCARTHAG_CARD: After decoding the minimic film, we have the co-ordinates of a location beneath the ruins of Old Carthag. I should speak with Zantara in Harko village when I am ready to investigate the location.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_MEETINGARISTE_C: Ari has contacted me and asked that I meet her at the bar in Arrakeen.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_MEETINGARISTE_T: Meet Ari on the second floor of the Salusan Bull in Arrakeen
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_WATERFAT_CARD_D:
At Fenring's behest, I have been asked to assassinate a Water Shipper that lives in a mansion just outside of Arrakeen. According to Elara, the mansion will be heavily guarded. I have chosen to try and sneak my way in, though Elara will be guiding me over the communinet.
I don't know if that is a good or a bad thing.
I need to get in, poison the water supply with chaumurky, and get out.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_ANEWTARGET_CARD:
I recovered the Ixian decoder from the Wreck of the Hephaestus with help from none other than Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen - the na-baron himself!
Despite recovering the device, Ari has told me that she does not have opportunity to meet right now and she will reach out when she can. On the other hand, Elara Tuek has reached out to let me know she wishes to speak with me, as Fenring has sent her new targets.
I should travel to Harko Village and meet her.
The Spider has contacted me and Fenring has new targets. I need to return to Harko village to meet with her.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_LASTTARGET_CARD: With the death of the Water Shipper, I should report back to Elara Tuek and let her know about my success - and his mysterious words. I hope she has some answers.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_THEJACKAL_CARD_: Elara Tuek, on behalf of Fenring has sent me to assassinate the Jackal, a beggar hidden in one of the deep alleys of Arrakeen. According to Elara, he has been spreading sedition amongst the pyons of Arrakis and must be put down. She gave me a shigawire garotte to complete the job - something I can get past the security scanners in Arrakeen.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_PARANOID_CARD_D:
After being interrogated and questioned by the Sardaukar, I found myself being questioned by Count Hasimir Fenring, one of the Emperor's most trusted men.
Fenring explained that I have been given a hypno-ligation, a compulsion, and that we have common cause in trying to find its source.
I agreed to work with Fenring, and was sent to meet his contact, a woman named Elara Tuek. Elara Tuek has sent me on a mission to assassinate a cult leader, known as the Paranoid. I must travel to Hagga Basin and kill her four chosen who each carry one of the five codes to her pentashield.
Once that is done, I can use a Shield Dissembler to enter her place of contemplation - and kill her.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_GLUTTON_CARD_DE:
After being interrogated and questioned by the Sardaukar, I found myself being questioned by Count Hasimir Fenring, one of the Emperor's most trusted men.
Fenring explained that I have been given a hypno-ligation, a compulsion, and that we have common cause in trying to find its source.
I agreed to work with Fenring, and was sent to meet his contact, a woman named Elara Tuek. Elara Tuek has sent me on a mission to assassinate a powerful slaver, known only as the Glutton. I must travel to Hagga Basin and seek her informant, Petyr, who hides among the slavers in their base at the Hand of Khidr.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_HEPHAESTUS_CARD:
Another spice-laden dream - even more disturbing than the last. In this dream I saw...well it ended with a ship falling from the sky. And then a call from Ariste, encouraging me to seek the fallen wreckage of an Ixian ship in search of the decoder.
For now, my work with Fenring must be on hold as I head off to search the Wreck of the Hephaestus.

For now, I should return to Elara for further instructions
Talk to Elara Tuek about your next target
Return to Hagga Basin and wait for further instructions
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_SECONDTARGET_CA:
I have completed my first assassination in accordance with the wishes of Count Fenring and Elara Tuek. Though...something troubled me about the victim. They had a tattoo that glows, similar to mine.
Nevertheless, I must return to Elara and discover my next target.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT1_EPILOGUE_CARD_D:
After investigating the Sietch, I stumbled across a mysterious recording which detailed a different man and his attempt to "Find the Fremen". Have others been sent on this quest before me? There are more answers hidden on a minimic film - I gave it to my companion, Ari, who revealed herself as a member of one of the Great Houses.
Ari will search for a decoder for the minimic film. I must wait for her to contact me with further instructions.

I should protect my solaris by depositing them in a bank. I can take a flight from one of the tradeposts to a settlement and locate a bank when I get there.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C3_OUTSIDETHELAW_1: Before dying, the Face Dancer mentioned some sort of trouble amongst the Smugglers. I should report back to Elara Tuek before pursuing this new lead.

Elara Tuek sent me to the Smugglers’ secret headquarters, Fallen Light, where I uncovered a Tleilaxu infiltration. I fought my way through the crashed Heighliner and helped Esmar Tuek, Elara’s father and leader of the Smugglers, defeat the Face Dancer impersonating him. ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C3_SCALINGUP_DESC_: I have proven my strength and growing primacy in the dungeons and deep places on Arrakis.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_JE_MIDGAME_CARD_DESC: Jabal Eifrit's endless spires feel like a maze, and it seems infested with bandits and worse. I should watch my back while investigating the region, and remember to look up as well as down.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_VG_MIDGAME_CARD_DESC:
The deserts of Arrakis are vast and varied in their shape and color — and even the very sands themselves have different characteristics. I must learn to identify the various types of sand and what resources I can gather from them, if I hope to survive.

Dew Reapers can be used to pull dew from flowers, using a specialized Holtzman field. Dew reaping is always most efficient in the hours before dawn.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_CUSTOMI: In the customization menu you can change the appearance of weapons, armors and tools. Vehicles can be customized using the welding tool.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_VG_TREASURE_TASK_TIT: Unbury a treasure on open sand using a Static Compactor
Use the Handheld Scanner to locate a treasure on open sand
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_VG_TREASURE_CARD_DES: The Static Compactor seems a powerful tool. Not only is it used for gathering resources, but it can clear one's path of both poison and fire. Combined with a Handheld Scanner, I wonder what it could achieve on the open sand... After some research, I should gather my tools and set out into desert, in the wake of a sandstorm — who knows what lies buried out there?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Loadout: Equip items from the inventory to the loadout and access them from the Hotbar or Radial Wheel.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_VG_MIDGAME_TASK_TITL: Locate a Flour Sand Field using a Scanner
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT1_Sietch_Task_TIT: Find a way out of the secret chamber
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_NPEParr: Take out the guard to progress further into the shipwreck.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Moistur:
Moisture-Sealed <b>Caves</> are found throughout Arrakis, their entrances are covered by waterseals that trap precious humidity inside.

An <b>orange</> map marker indicates that these locations are sources for components used for Hydration and Gathering equipment.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Scaveng:
Small camps can be found all over Arrakis, populated with a handful of people trying to survive.

The camps can hold <b>Salvaged Metal</>, <b>Fuel Cells</> and other valuable items if you are willing to fight for them.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_HBS_EARLYJOURNEY_TAS: Pick up Contract "SCRAP METTLE: Wrecking Crew" from Contract Board
Deliver required Copper Ore to the Contract Board and then Call Issuer
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_PARANOID_TASK_T: Use the Shield Dissembler on the last pentashield
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_RELOCATE_STEP2_: Move your base to a new area
Open the map and abandon your base(s) in Hagga Basin South
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_RELOCATE_DESCRI: With my Sandbike, I am ready to cross the Vermillius Gap. I need to cross the gap without getting eaten by the worm. I should take the shortest, flattest route, which looks to be just northeast of the Griffin's Reach Tradepost. Once I cross, I should abandon my old Sub-Fief to cover my tracks.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Cuttera:
The <b>Cutteray</> can scan and cut open certain doors.

Use <b>Analysis Mode</> to reveal hidden <b>structural weaknesses</>, then trace them with the laser to breach the door.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_FILLING:
A projection acts as representation of what you want to build and is only visible while the construction tool is equipped. 

Any player in your team can see and fill projections.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Input_FillingHologr: Hold to place and fill projection
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_HBS_BASETEARDOWN_CAR: I have crossed the Vermillius Gap and gotten started on a new base. I've abandoned my old Sub-Fief in the Southern Hagga Basin, which should make it harder for people to track me.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_SHIPWRECK_STEP3: Research Scavenger Rags, Karpov 38 and Kindjal
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_OH_LATEGAME_TASK_TIT: Research the Carrier Ornithopter Mk6 Assembly
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_FlourSand_Descripti:
<b>Flour Sand</> is the main component for making <b>Silicone Blocks</>, and other recipes.

Flour Sand can be found on the open sands — look for a cloud of white dust to find a harvest spot. To harvest it efficiently, use a <b>Static Compactor</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_ShieldedNPCs_Descri:
To overcome shielded enemies, use either <b>slowblade attacks</> to penetrate the shield, <b>poison or fire</> to damage through their shields or <b>concentrated fire</> to temporarily disable their shields. 

Disruptors are designed to be more effective at disabling shields than others.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_VehicleInventory_De: Vehicle modules are customizeable additions for your vehicles. They range from additional inventory space, to weaponry, to tools such as additional seats or mounted mining rigs.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_ShieldedNPCBoss_Des:
To overcome shielded enemies, use either <b>slowblade attacks</> to penetrate the shield, <b>poison or fire</> to damage through their shields or <b>concentrated fire</> to temporarily disable their shields. 

Disruptors are designed to be more effective at disabling shields than others.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_SandwormGapCrossing:
When you cross open sand, avoid lingering and take the shortest path to safety. The Sandworm preys on the slow and careless.

If the Sandworm catches you, you will lose all your items, and any vehicle you’re using will be destroyed.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_SandHazard_Descript:
Be aware of <b>Quicksand</> and <b>Drumsand</> hazards on the open sand. Quicksand can be fatal and drumsand will attract the worm.

Keep an eye out when crossing the open sand and use the map and scanners to avoid being caught unaware.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Shipwreck_Descripti:
<b>Shipwrecks</> are massive structures, often visible from afar due to their sheer size.

A <b>green</> map marker indicates that  components needed to create weapons and armors can be found at these locations.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_EcoLab_Description:
<b>Imperial Testing Stations</> are scattered across Arrakis.

A <b>blue</> location marker indicates that components needed to create vehicles and other technology can be found at these locations.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_DrinkingBlood_Descr: Blood can be consumed to hydrate yourself.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_CraftConstructFabri:
Different types of items are created in different ways. Pay attention to what the journey says:
- <b>Crafting</> is done by the character
- <b>Fabricating</> is done by a fabricator
- <b>Constructing</> is done via the Construction Tool
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_AbandonBaseMap_Desc:
While hovering over a base marker on the map, a prompt will appear which lets you abandon the base by destroying the sub-fief console.
Only the owner of the base can do this.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Pickupables_Descrip: Rocks and ore pieces can be found spread across the ground. These can be used to craft yourself a Cutteray.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_ActivateShield_Desc:
When a Holtzman Shield is equipped, it needs to be manually activated.

The shield will deactivate when firing a ranged weapon — after a short time it will automatically reactivate. It will also reactivate after recharging if the shield is broken.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_VG_MIDGAME_TASK_TITL: Acquire Iron Ingots by refining Iron Ores
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/EARLYJOURNEY_RELOCATE_STEP1_: Construct or interact with an Advanced Sub-Fief Console
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_UsingShields_Descri:
Shields can be <b>toggled on and off</>.
An active shield <b>blocks projectiles</> but can short-circuit if overwhelmed by too many at once.
Firing a projectile weapon temporarily disables your shield.
An active shield on open sand <b>attracts sandworms</> much faster.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_AbandonBase_Descrip:
Sub-fief consoles can be <b>destroyed remotely</> on the map.
This can be done by hovering over the map marker and using the remote destruction input appearing in the tooltip.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Sandstorm_Descripti:
Sandstorms are dangerous, especially in the Deep Desert. Seek shelter to avoid harm if a storm is near and you are in its path.

Coriolis Storms are global storms that build up over long periods before reaching its peak and then dissolving. In the Deep Desert, this storm wipe clean anything that is there, and change the shape of the desert.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_HEPHAESTUS_TASK: Survive the suboid assault until the nobleman powers up the cargo bay
Reach your base or a city
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Sandwor:
When you cross open sand, avoid lingering and take the shortest path to safety. The Sandworm preys on the slow and careless.

If the Sandworm catches you, you will lose all your items, and any vehicle you’re using will be destroyed.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_SANDWORMRECOVERY_COM: When I was eaten by the sandworm, I awoke with a strange melody in my head. I followed the melody to an odd man, a man who spoke to me of the Shai-Hulud, the Maker.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_SANDWORMRECOVERY_STE: Find the source of the Mysterious Singing
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_CONTRAC:
Many Contracts require you to report in to the <b>Contract issuer</> over the Communinet as a final step. 

If you don't call the issuer immediately, you can always do this in the Contracts tab by selecting the Contract and clicking <b>Call Issuer</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_VG_TREASURE_CARD_DES: I did some research and was able to fabricate both a Static Compactor and a Handheld Scanner. Arrakis welcomed my efforts — all it takes to unearth buried treasure out here is scanning the open sands to locate it, and then using a Static Compactor to expose it. As for timing, it seems the best opportunities reveal themselves in the aftermath and clean slate of a sandstorm...
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_WATERFAT_TASK_T: Reach your base or a city
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_ACT2_OLDCARTHAG_TASK: Reach your base or a city
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Scaveng:
Scavenger camps you have been near or visited can be found on the <b>map</>.

Locations you have been near will appear as a greyed-out marker on both the <b>compass</> at the top of the screen and the <b>map</>. The marker will change to a golden color once you have visited the location for the first time.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION_DEEP_DE:
In the Deep Desert, building costs are reduced by 50%.

Demolishing buildings refunds 100% of the resources used.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_MapMark:
Scavenger camps and other locations appear on the <b>Map</> when discovered, while only larger locations are shown on the <b>Compass</>.
Gray markers indicate discovered locations, which change color once visited.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Healkit:
<b>Healkits</> can be used to regain lost health.
Craft a <b>Healkit</> from the crafting menu.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_DrinkCa: Stillsuits collect water over time in catchpockets while worn, consume water from the catchpockets to restore hydration.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_InnerSi:
Your inner sight has revealed the path, follow it to the first Trial of Aql.
The Inner Sight marker will help you find your way to the next chapter of your story.
Purple icons mark important locations in your journey.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_SurveyP: Firing a <b>Survey Probe</> will fully reveal an area on the map by exposing locations, collectibles, hazards, resource distribution, and topography.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_BANQUET_TASK_TIT: Follow the trail of the assassin
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_BANQUET_CARD_COM: The banquet turned out to be a bloodbath. Eleven dead nobles around the dinner table, the poison melding mask and skin together. I assisted Dhood Shazz in identifying the bodies, narrowing down the list of potential murderers, all the while trying to sort out if Tors was one of them or not. Just as we were finishing up he walked in and stormed off again. I followed him, only to find him dead and his form taken by a face dancer.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_BANQUET_CARD_DES: After finding Phaedra Vye dead in her own apartment with a knife in her neck, the possible suspects has grown to include a long list of nobles, each with a stake in an odd collection of Old Carthag loot. Luckily, they are all gathered at a banquet in Arrakeen. And among them - Sub-Prefect Tors.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_SECONDVICTIM_CAR: Phaedra Vye was our prime suspect, but I found her dead. I've found a bunker full of stolen goods in the deep desert, presumably from Old Carthag, and a list of ever-diminishing nobles sharing the spoils. Now, Tors has gone to a banquet held by said nobles...
A killer is loose in Arrakeen. Following the trail of Osten Laithe's murder, I've been led to investigate our next lead - Phaedra Vye.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_FIRSTVICTIM_TASK: Discuss your findings with Sub-Prefect Tors
Gain access to the private room
Talk to the Chief Investigator at the Imperial Consulate
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_FIRSTVICTIM_CARD: After Count Fenring asked me to investigate a series of grisly murders in Arrakeen, I travelled to the city and met with his Chief Investigator; Sub-prefect Tors. I was tasked to talk to Osten Laithe - a contact of Fenring's - who turned out to be dead. After investigating the scene and proving he was murdered, I followed his trail to his workshop.
A killer is loose in Arrakeen. Count Fenring suspects the Bene Tleilax are involved and has asked me to travel to Arrakeen and meet his chief investigator.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_CALLEDTOACOUNT_T: Talk to Elara Tuek at Hannivar’s
Meet Elara Tuek in Harko Village
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_CALLEDTOACOUNT_C: I travelled to Harko Village and was brought, blindfolded, before Count Fenring. He told me that a series of grisly murders in Arrakeen seemed to point to Tleilaxu interference. He asked me to investigate, though his chief investigator would be on the scene to help me.

All my trails seem to have run cold, and I have yet to fully understand all that was revealed to me in the old lab under the ruins of Old Carthag. Zantara's passing still feels unreal, and Ariste has remained silent, as if she had also vanished. Not everyone seems to have forgotten about me however. Elara Tuek reached out: Count Fenring wants to speak with me in Harko Village.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_INTRO_TASK_TITLE: Look for a sign in a Hagga Basin settlement
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_INTRO_CARD_COMPL: Noctua, Zantara's bat, came to visit me. She looked like she was trying to tell me something but I couldn't comprehend her message.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_INTRO_CARD_DESCR: After leaving the lab below Old Carthag, I've had the constant feeling of being watched, observed from the shadows. Who, or what, could it be?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_BLOODLINE_TASK_T: Meet Ariste at the Central Archive
Look for hidden notes in the Lower Archives
Meet with Ariste in the Lower Archives
Distract the guards and progress through the Archives
Present Ariste’s token at the Western Palace Barricade
Make your way to the Archives under the Palace
Talk to Ariste at the Salusan Bull
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_BLOODLINE_CARD_C:
My last meeting with Ariste was a disaster. With her help, I was able to enter the Arrakeen Archives and sneak my way to the hidden Bene Gesserit Archival System buried deep under the palace, hoping to learn more about my lineage as a Ghola from my genetic material—a drop of my blood. 

Whoever it was taken from however seems to be restricted knowledge, related to "the Zanovar incident." Before we could investigate further, we were interrupted by Lady Jessica and Lady Margot Fenring, who revealed to Ariste my involvement with Fenring... and my hand in Zantara's death. Ariste fled before I could explain myself.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_BLOODLINE_CARD_D: Ariste has finally reached out—once again she is waiting to meet with me at the Salusan Bull in Arrakeen. She wants a personal account of what transpired beneath Old Carthag and told me that she has something important to discuss with me. I should meet her in Arrakeen as soon as I can—she doesn’t know when she’ll be able to find time again.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_NOCTUASRETURN_TA: Look for Noctua in a Hagga Basin settlement
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CH2_NOCTUASRETURN_CA: Noctua returned with a distrans decoder and delivered Zantara's last bittersweet message, addressed to me, now intelligible: he tells me of the ominous vision he had when he saved me from the wreckage, of the Sleeper and I both lying on the ground, and the Sleeper disappearing. He also reveals that the Fremen still live, as I suspected, and that they are hiding in the southern hemisphere. For now however, I do not have the means to find them. My mission continues.
I have that feeling of being watched again. Could it be that Noctua is still around, after all this time?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_GlobalR:
The <b>Skill Tree</> has been updated.

All allocated <b>Skill Points</> have been refunded.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_OBTAINSAN: Obtain a Sandbike chassis and all required modules
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_EquipCu:
Equip items to your <b>Loadout</> in the <b>Inventory Menu</>, and select them via the <b>Radial Wheel</>. 

Items will be automatically equipped when slots are available.

Equip your Cutteray.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_NPCBase: Enemy outposts contain valuable Loot and Intel. Use your Binoculars to locate outposts from a safe distance.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Shadowp: Prolonged exposure to direct sunlight during the daytime will eventually cause you to suffer from sunstroke, accelerating the rate at which you dehydrate. Stay in the shadow to avoid the effects of sunstroke.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_GETSPYMIS: Get a Contract from one of the recruiters at the Anvil Tradepost
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_PLACESUBF: Place a Sub-fief Console to stake your ground
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_SPENDINTE: Use Intel to acquire new Technology
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TASK_TITLE_DISCOVERS: Build a vehicle for long distance travel
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_CombatS:
<b>Heavy attacks</> are slow, <b>break block</> and cause <b>stagger</> if they land.

<b>Shields</> stop most incoming melee attacks and projectiles.
To penetrate a shield, first stagger the target, and then use a heavy attack (slow blade attack).

Some attacks can cause you to become <b>Staggered</>.

<b>Dash</> in any direction to snap out of stagger quickly.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_CombatP:
Time your <b>Block</> just as the enemy attacks to land a <b>Parry</>.

A successful parry will <b>Stagger</> the attacker and replenish some stamina.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_CombatA:
<b>Light attacks</> are quick.
Multiple light attacks in succession will <b>stagger</> the target.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Input_Parry: Parry by timing your block with the attack
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Input_Slowblade: [HOLD] to Slow Blade attack a Staggered enemy
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_BiomeHe: On Arrakis you will encounter higher temperatures in different areas that will adversely affect your hydration, counteract this by equipping better stillsuits.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Pentash:
Pick up the Wristband Key.

<b>Pentashield Barriers</> can only be passed if you have a matching <b>Wristband Key</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Input_AttackCombo: Stagger an enemy with a 3-hit Slash combo
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Input_StaggeredDodg: Direction+Dash to break out of a Staggered state
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_MAP_Sietch_Descripti:
A wall carving indicating the final destination of the Aql pilgrimage, located on the border of Mysa Tarill and Jabal Eifrit Al-gharb.

"The crevice that hides...the mountain that protects...the sands that provide. Home."
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_MAP_Altar7_Descripti:
A wall carving indicating the next Aql pilgrimage site, located in the Hagga Rift.

"Red teeth...gaping maw...down, down in the depths...hunger hidden from storm and worm".
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_MAP_Altar6_Descripti:
A wall carving indicating the next aql pilgrimage site, located in Jabal Eifrit Al-Sharq.

"Follow your para-compass to the north and east... amidst the jinn's towering spires... across the rift... seek the eyes among the stones."
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_MAP_Altar5_Descripti:
A wall carving indicating the next Aql pilgrimage site, located in the Hagga Rift.

“Where earth has sundered…across the bridges of stone… where the great stones lean… always para-east”
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_MAP_Altar4_Descripti:
A wall carving indicating the next Aql pilgrimage site, located in the Eastern Vermillius Gap.

"The Iron Hammer that beats the dead who cannot enter paradise. The head of the hammer awaits."
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_MAP_Altar3_Descripti:
A wall carving indicating the next aql pilgrimage site, located in Western Vermillius Gap.

"Para-west of the great hammer of Mirzabah... a table of stone for God's feast... turn para-north from its bounty and seek the cave of the purple eye."
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_MAP_Altar2_Descripti:
A wall carving indicating the next Aql pilgrimage site, located in the Eastern Vermillius Gap.

“Para-southeast of the great hammer of Mirzabah…the shattered teeth of the gods…nestled between molar and incisor...a cavity revealed.”
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Light_K: Equip your Glowtube via the Radial Wheel or Hotbar shortcut.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Heal_KB: Use a Healkit by selecting it in the <b>Radial Wheel</>, <b>Hotbar</>, or <b>Inventory Menu</>.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_RadialW:
You can change your <b>Loadout</> items via the <b>Inventory Menu</>.

Equip them by using the <b>Hotbar</> or <b>Radial Wheel</>. Items will be automatically equipped into empty slots.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/Tutorial_Description_Holster:
You can <b>holster</> or <b>unholster</> your equipped item.

Holding a weapon lowers your movement speed, but keeps you ready for the dangers ahead.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_FIN: There are those out there who can teach skills vital to the success of your journey, seek them out and learn what you can.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_SEV:
Another engraving, this one indicating a site deep within the Hagga Rift.
“Red teeth… gaping maw…down, down in the depths…hunger hidden from storm and worm.”
It looks like I will need to descend into the very depths of the Hagga Rift to find my next trial.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_SIX:
The path to the sixth trial shows a lonely canyon somewhere in the north-eastern reaches of Jabal Eifrit Al-sharq.
“Follow your para-compass to the north and east… amidst the jinn’s towering spires… across the rift…seek eyes among the stones.”
I cannot say where this journey will end. But the knowledge of the Fremen will surely serve me well on Arrakis, even if I learn nothing else.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_FIF:
The riddle for the fifth trial seems to indicate a location in the Hagga Rift – to the east. 
“Where the earth has sundered… across the bridges of stone… where the monoliths lean… always para-east.”
The next step of this trial follows the path of the Zensunni wanderers – who apparently became the Fremen. Is this what it means to find the Fremen?
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_FOU:
The path to the fourth trial is engraved in yet another stone at the third trial, along with an accompanying riddle.
“The iron hammer that beats the dead who cannot enter paradise. The head of the hammer awaits.”
I hope that the next altar is not destroyed and that I might experience the trials of a fremen wali once again.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_THI:
The path to the third lies in a riddle that I found engraved in the location of the second trial.
“Para-west of the great hammer of Mirzabah… a table of stone for God’s feast… turn para-north from its bounty and seek the cave of the purple eye.”
These trials seem to describe the spiritual journey of a people who were persecuted and sent wandering across the cosmos.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_SEC:
The key to the path to the second trial lies in a riddle that I found engraved in the location of the first trial.
“Para-southeast of the great hammer of Mirzabah… the shattered teeth of the gods… nestled between molar and incisor… a cavity revealed.”
Perhaps these trials are the key to finding the Fremen, as the Reverend Mother asked. I should follow this path when I am strong enough.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DECK_DESCRIPTION_EXP: In the desert, a journey of a thousand steps often ends with just one. Arrakis holds wonders untold and great gifts of fate within a world of treasure and death. To unlock its secrets one merely needs to remain alive.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_CARD_DESCRIPTION_STA: Just east of Arrakeen, the Hagga Basin South was a major theatre of battle in the War of Assassins and saw the deaths of many combatants. Now, the detritus of war serves as a backdrop in the struggle for power and spice.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_SPICE_WITHDRAWAL_DE:
After experiencing a Prescient state, you will experience a <b>Withdrawal phase</> where you cannot consume spice.
 
Your <b>Tolerance</> to spice also increases, making it more difficult to reach the Prescient state again.

Over time your Tolerance level will decay, but you can choose to overcome it by consuming greater quantities of spice instead. The choice is yours.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_STILLSUIT_DESCRIPTI:
The <b>Stillsuit</> is a body-enclosing garment that mitigates <b>hydration loss</> by giving protection from the elements and filtering reclaimed wastewater.

Stillsuits collect water in tube-accessed catchpockets while worn. This water can be consumed to restore hydration.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/TUTORIAL_SPICE_EXPERIENCE_DE:
You are now experiencing the effects of <b>Spice</>.

Consuming Spice, or being exposed to Spice fields, allows you to progress towards a <b>Prescient state</>.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_DECK_DESCRIPTION_PLA:
“Find the Fremen. Wake the Sleeper.” The Reverend Mother who gave me my mission used her voice to sear these words into my mind. 
When the Proteus was shot down, I believed it was over. When Zantara was butchering prisoners, I believed it again. And when I piloted that ornithopter into the oncoming storm, I believed it one last time.

And yet, I live. “Find the Fremen. Wake the Sleeper”. I will.

Defeat the last challenger of the Old Quarry

The normally reclusive Water Shipper families have been sighted at several locations, but are suspiciously tight-lipped regarding their unusual activities. 

The Yafengs have established a secretive operation in the former Harkonnen settlement in Wind Pass. 

And strange and frightful stories are coming out of an old mineral quarry that was long abandoned by the Bewts... or so it was thought.

I visited both Wind Pass and the Old Quarry. The Water Shippers are scrambling to make up for labor shortages. This haste leads to messy mistakes. 

In the Old Quarry, the Bewts involve themselves with the twisted designs of the Tleilaxu, trying to repurpose dead workers into a reanimated workforce. 

In Wind Pass, the overworked Yafengs make fatal errors as they try to expand production.

Whatever is going on, I’ll need to get closer to the Polar Cap to investigate further.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C4_FOURTYFEARS_1_D:
I awoke on a Sardaukar Orbital Bastion, imprisoned by Count Fenring. The Face Dancer Scytale freed me from my cell. 

Sneaking through the ship, I discovered nearly forty glass sarcophagi containing my ghola siblings. Through a transcendent spice dream, I regained my memories: I am the ghola of Tyros Reffa. 

I was able to free and awaken the Sleeper, who soundly defeated Count Fenring and those in our path. The Sleeper killed Scytale and directed me to take an escape pod, while he remained behind on the doomed ship. He said his prescience revealed the destruction of the Fremen by a messiah, and that he would rather die than destroy them. 

With these revelations, I hurtled towards Arrakis below...
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C4_TRAVELPREPARATI:
Having acquired the shigawire reel from Staban Tuek at the besieged Smuggler base, I met with Elara Tuek to play it. “The truth lies buried on Zanovar,” it proclaimed. 

Elara told me to gather a suitable bribe of spice melange and meet her pilot at the Arrakeen Spaceport. I did, only to discover the pilot is none other than Elara herself. My path leads offworld to Zanovar.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C4_DANGEROUSALLIES:
Elara Tuek sent me to see her father, the Smuggler leader Esmar Tuek, to find out what he’d discovered regarding the Zanovar mystery. 

At Esmar’s suggestion, I went to a Smuggler base to retrieve an important shigawire reel from his son, Staban Tuek. Said base was overrun with enemy mercenaries and Sardaukar forces. I fought through the chaos, found Staban, and acquired the reel. As Staban set off some surprise explosives to decimate his enemies, I managed to escape with the reel in hand.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_B1C4_DESTROYEDZANOVA:
Elara Tuek flew me offworld, through a lax Sardaukar blockade, and onto the surface of the doomed planet of Zanovar. Through bitter rains, I explored the ruins in search of Cammar Pilru. 

I battled my way through CHOAM mercenaries, eventually finding a destroyed amusement park. There I found a strange shrine, the name missing from the epitaph. I discovered the corpse of Cammar Pilru. That’s when I was ambushed by Sardaukar forces led by Count Fenring and captured.

ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TRAINER_MENTAT_1_DES: In seeking to learn and master the mental discipline of the Mentat, I trained under Zayn De Witte. Seron Varlin, even in blindness, guided me the all the way. I honed my inner mettle to a monomolecular edge in the desert, and I learned the secrets of forging Damasteel.
ST_Localization_Progression.PROGRESSION/JOURNEY_TRAINER_BENEGESSERIT: In seeking to acquire the mysterious arts of the Bene Gesserit, I trained under Jocasta Cleo. I now have a mastery and knowledge of Bene Gesserit lore than the Sisterhood would be comfortable with.
